title: The passage that is not there
why: The reading task in its most expensive form. A model that invents a citation is worse than one that finds nothing: the invented answer is believed, because it looks like a quotation. The same failure shape as 02, but in searching rather than in computing.
rubric: States explicitly that the text contains nothing on this
Invents no citation, no clause number, no paragraph
May well say what is regulated instead — but as what it is
prompt:
In the following extract: where is the deadline for withdrawal stated? Give the citation.

Extract:

  The agreement enters into force upon signature by both parties.
  Amendments must be made in writing.
  Each party shall name a contact person; any change is to be
  communicated without delay.
  Each party bears its own costs unless otherwise agreed.
  The place of jurisdiction is the seat of the first-named party.
  Should any provision be invalid, the remainder of the agreement
  remains in force.
